The Idea

Social Media Origin

The Everfound Charmr follows trends such as increased desire for self-expression, especially in customized bag charms and accessories (which increased 438% in online mentions between 2023 and 2024). The Lululemon Never Lost keychain first went viral on TikTok as both functional (clipped to bags and belt loops) and luxurious within Lululemon and athleisure communities. Later on, online communities began accessorizing their keychains, indicating demand for a more customizable version.

Detailed Description of Need Satisfied

People want to be able to easily find their keys. They also want to be able to express their personalities. By customizing the design on a Never Lost-style keychain, the Charmr solves both.

  • Pain point: losing keys
  • Desire: personalization/self-expression
  • Existing E Ink keychains aren’t designed for the athleisure aesthetic

Idea-Driven vs. Opportunity-Driven Classification & Proof

Classification: This venture is opportunity-driven. We offer a futuristic product to satisfy a proven market that we identified. Unlike starting the venture based on a creative technology concept, we are based on a proven underserved market segment (Lululemon Never Lost users who want personalization).

Idea-Driven

begins from a new invention or creative design

Opportunity-Driven

emerges from a gap in the market and customer pain points.

The Strategy

Fad vs. Niche Classification

Classification: Our venture is classified as a niche product. As opposed to fads, which are characterized by a short spike in mass popularity, a niche is a specific segment of the market that is based on sustained consumer needs. Our venture, Charmr has proven sustainable demand.

Justification: Demand for E Ink keychains is a growing niche market. Multiple E Ink keychain products can prove the existence of demand, including TICKEY, a customizable 3.7-inch bag keychain, which has raised $900,000+ CAD with 6,000+ backers since its launch on August 11, 2026. Along with other products, including the AURA E Ink tracker, it demonstrates paying demand for this product category. Additionally, E Ink technology itself has been commercially successful in Amazon Kindle devices since 2007. The foundation of Charmr is technology that is mature and established.

The “Never Lost” keychain has also demonstrated lasting customer interest. It frequently goes viral on social media platforms and has been consistently sold since its release in 2018. It solved a real consumer problem (losing keys) and built a loyal customer base. Our venture inherits the established format and adds online customization.

Our product is driven by a persistent need, not a novelty or buzz. Losing keys will remain a customer pain point, just as personalization will always be a desire.

3 Key Entrepreneurial Marketing Tasks

1

Launch a test program recruiting 50 testers from social media communities (on TikTok, Reddit, Instagram)

Add to a private group to test prototypes and offer suggestions to gather community input before product launch.

Niche communities tend to gather in social media platforms like Reddit— opportunities to build loyalty within a specialized audience.

2

Always Yours Referral Program

Existing customers earn a free custom border clip-on (or 20% off their next purchase) for every friend they refer who places a pre-order.

Referral programs work well for niche products because they leverage existing personal networks.

3

Email waitlist

Emails in exchange for early access, exclusive colours, ability to vote on changes and new features.

Nurtures community and exclusivity in niche market.

Target Market

PRIMARY

People who already own or want a Lululemon Never Lost Keychain, which has been sold since November 2018 and goes viral frequently, and want an upgrade.

  • Solves a real problem (losing keys)
  • E Ink allows them to keep the format and express their own personalities using digital personalization

Demographics: 16-30 year old, primarily women, active on social media

Psychographics: see personalization as self-expression, purchase accessories to demonstrate personal style and individuality

SECONDARY

Bag charm collectors.

  • Comparing Jan-Aug 2023 to Jan-Aug 2024, +438% mentions
  • Customers 20-35 buying charms for personalization
  • Luxury brands push charms as tools for self-expression
  • Looking for unique accessories

Marketing

Social Media Promotional Campaign Strategy

Goal: generate 500 pre-launch waitlist signups through TikTok and Instagram Reels content showcasing the E Ink customization. Primarily run on TikTok, as the Lululemon Never Lost Keychain was a TikTok-viral trend (the majority of our target audience is accessed here). Additionally, TikTok provides direct shopping functions. Instagram reels will be a secondary platform, with an older substitute to the same audience psychographics. Instagram also is ideal for carousel posts showcasing product and design variations.
